crossRefs.note: Isaac called Jacob, blessed him, and commanded him, “You shall not take a wife of the daughters of Canaan.
I will make you swear by Yahweh, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you shall not take a wife for my son…
When Esau was forty years old, he took as wife Judith, the daughter of Beeri the Hittite, and Basemath, the daughter of…
They grieved Isaac’s and Rebekah’s spirits.
But the thing displeased Samuel, when they said, “Give us a king to judge us.” Samuel prayed to Yahweh.

people.name: Canaan

people.name: Esau
people.line: Isaac's firstborn son; sold birthright to Jacob; became Edom.

people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

translations.web: Esau saw that the daughters of Canaan didn’t please Isaac, his father.
